items.title: UK to explore even closer ties with EU after agreeing deal, says Burnham
items.description: The UK-EU deal agreed on Friday covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.

items.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
items.description: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

items.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
items.description: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.

items.title: Anthropic shares fall after blockbuster opening as wider tech sell-off continues
items.description: Other tech companies have also taken a hit as share markets broadly slump.

items.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
items.description: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.

items.title: Texas death-row inmate screams as execution takes more than one hour
items.description: This prolonged execution comes weeks after Christa Pike survived the lethal injection of the same drug.

items.title: Indian man sentenced to 19-plus years in plot to assassinate US-based Sikh separatist leader
items.description: Nikhil Gupta pleaded guilty to murder-for-hire, conspiracy to commit murder-for-hire, and conspiracy to commit money laundering in February.
